metadata.description: Primary standards, implementation guides, and tooling references for accessibility engineering.
metadata.title: Software Accessibility - Sources

standards.name: WCAG 2.2
standards.description: Current W3C accessibility baseline for digital products.

standards.name: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
standards.description: Canonical widget patterns, keyboard behavior, and ARIA guidance.

standards.name: EN 301 549
standards.description: European accessibility requirements for ICT procurement and compliance.

standards.name: Section 508
standards.description: US federal accessibility requirements and implementation guidance.

standards.name: European Accessibility Act
standards.description: Official EAA legal text for digital accessibility obligations in the EU market.

standards.name: European Commission EAA Notice
standards.description: European Commission guidance on EAA application timing and business obligations.

standards.name: Federal Register — DOJ ADA Title II Web/Mobile Compliance-Date Extension
standards.description: DOJ Interim Final Rule, effective 20 April 2026, extending ADA Title II web/mobile-app compliance dates by one year (population 50,000+: 26 Apr 2027; under 50,000 or special districts: 26 Apr 2028). Technical standard remains WCAG 2.1 AA. Verify comment-period outcome before citing as final.

standards.name: W3C WCAG 3 Introduction
standards.description: Current status of the WCAG 3.0 Working Draft; use to verify draft date, outcome count, and conformance-tier model before citing 3.0 details.

implementation_and_tooling.name: axe-core
implementation_and_tooling.description: Widely used automation library for accessibility rule checks.

implementation_and_tooling.name: Playwright Accessibility Testing
implementation_and_tooling.description: Playwright guidance for accessibility assertions in E2E tests.

implementation_and_tooling.name: The A11Y Project
implementation_and_tooling.description: Practical accessibility checklists and implementation articles.

implementation_and_tooling.name: WebAIM
implementation_and_tooling.description: Accessibility implementation resources, tools, and testing guidance.

implementation_and_tooling.name: FTC Decision and Order — accessiBe
implementation_and_tooling.description: FTC final order (approved April 2025) fining accessiBe $1,000,000 for deceptive claims that its overlay widget automatically achieved WCAG compliance. Cite as grounds against recommending overlays as a compliance solution; verify current status before citing as ongoing litigation.
